assumptions: The result aligns to the design under the scoring given.
limits: Positions the result does not cover are reported as uncovered, never as matching.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does the sequencing result differ from the designed construct, and what does each difference land in?

description: Compare a sequencing RESULT against the construct you designed and say what differs, where, and what it lands in. Aligns the two, reports every substitution, indel and uncalled position, then maps each onto the design's features and ranks them by Ensembl's published consequence severity — so a pipeline can gate on 'nothing worse than synonymous' rather than on a bare difference count.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

band_margin.description: alignment limit `bandMargin`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

confident_coverage.description: alignment limit `confidentCoverage`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

design.description: the construct you INTENDED — wire an upstream record or name a library document. Its features come with it, and they are what turns a difference into a consequence.

gap_extend.description: alignment limit `gapExtend`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

gap_open.description: alignment limit `gapOpen`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

match.description: alignment limit `match`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

min_coverage.description: alignment limit `minCoverage`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

min_result_fraction.description: alignment limit `minResultFraction`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

mismatch.description: alignment limit `mismatch`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

result.description: what actually came back from sequencing — wire a record or name a document.

word_size.description: alignment limit `wordSize`, as the Verify panel's own slider sets it. Advanced.

name: verify_construct

affectedFeatures.description: features with a real difference, missing bases or uncalled positions — worst first

differenceCount.description: substitutions, insertions and deletions found — NOT counting positions the sequencer could not call

differences.description: every difference with its 1-based position on the design and a one-line description

identity.description: positions where design and result agree, over the aligned length, as a PERCENTAGE — 100 for an exact match, not 1

largeEvents.description: structural events — a dropped cassette or a duplicated span reads as one event here rather than as hundreds of substitutions

report.description: the whole verification, including the alignment frame and band

uncalledPositions.description: positions the result could not call. Counted apart from differences on purpose: an uncalled base is not a mutation, and folding the two together reports a clean read as a damaged one

worstConsequence.description: the most severe consequence term any affected feature carries, by Ensembl's published ranking — the one value a gate should read
